guidetextdraw._value:
INSTRUCTIONS:
Fill in the information about the people that you (and your spouse) will support between July 1, 2021 and June 30, 2022. Incomplete documents
will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy.
This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textOne

guidetextdraw_203999_926182577._value:
INCLUDE:
-    yourself (list yourself on the first line),
-    your spouse (if you are married), and
-    your dependent children (if they receive more than half of their support from you or your spouse).
guidetextdraw_203999_926182577.name: textTwo

guidetextdraw_1022839905._value:
OTHER PEOPLE MAY BE INCLUDED ONLY IF THEY:
-   lived with and received more than half of their support from you or your spouse at the time you completed your
    California Dream Act Application
    AND
-   will continue to receive this support between July 1, 2022 and June 30, 2023.
guidetextdraw_1022839905.name: textdraw_10228399051644405829136

guidetextdraw_copy._value:
TELL US ABOUT YOUR FAMILY SIZE
List all family members that meet the definition listed above. In addition, check yes for each family member listed who is enrolled in six (6) or
more units that can be applied toward a college degree or certificate program. Attach a separate sheet if you need more space.
